catalog.scope: Discovery and guidance, not execution or scientific qualification. engineCLI is a command reference or null; http lists existing method/path references or is null. Null means no direct interface. mac describes the supported Mac command or app/engine handoff. Engine-only operations require that engine and its declared compute environment.

answerSchema.selection: Training/selection/test separation or explanation of why it does not apply
answerSchema.fields: Map of field IDs to text values. Omitted or blank optional fields use the interview default when present; required fields cannot be blank. Integers preserve their values without floating-point conversion.
answerSchema.advanced: Optional original config fields; cannot overwrite form fields
